title: Lupin the 3rd: The Master File
native_title: ルパン三世 ～ザ・マスター・ファイル～
overview: An animated reference guide to Lupin the 3rd, covering the anime from 1971 to 1994. Browse files on the gentleman thief's screen adventures, from the first TV series through Part III, along with TV specials, an original video and the theatrical films, all on one disc for fans of Lupin, Jigen, Goemon, Fujiko and Inspector Zenigata.
